scanned entry 31 1005
Entry thirty-one, written for this repository and for nothing else.
It stands where the game's own note would stand, so that a session can
open it, turn its pages and put it away without one word of anybody's
booklet being committed here.

The paragraph after this one is long on purpose. A page of the reader
is twenty rows of thirty-eight cells on the whole screen, so a note of
some nine hundred bytes is two pages of text, and the picture after it
is a third: which is what NEXT has to walk through and EXIT has to
leave from.

Wrapping happens at a space, so a run of ordinary words is what proves
it: alpha bravo charlie delta echo foxtrot golf hotel india juliett
kilo lima mike november oscar papa quebec romeo sierra tango uniform
victor whiskey xray yankee zulu, and round again, alpha bravo charlie
delta echo foxtrot golf hotel india juliett kilo lima mike november.

The last line of the text is here so that a person looking at the
screen can tell the end of the note from the end of a page.
